narrative.overview: Every leave request is a trip with stops: you → 林主管 → 王經理. v2 places that itinerary under a Liquid Glass layer, as iOS 27 and macOS 27 do: navigation and actions float as translucent glass above solid, legible content.
keyCharacteristics: Glass only on chrome: floating sidebar / tab bar, sheet, toolbar buttons, menus, toasts.
Solid content surfaces with 26px corners, no hairline borders; widgets instead of a single grouped strip.
Capsules for every control; the selected item is a raised lens that slides between options.
iOS 26 system colors as vivid fills, with darker text-safe shades for any colored text.
Reduce Transparency and Reduce Motion are honored: glass becomes solid, the lens stops gliding.

rules.name: The Glass Is Chrome Rule
rules.body: Glass is for things that float above content. Content always sits on a solid surface.

rules.name: The Two Shades Rule
rules.body: Vivid shade for fills and dots, darker shade for text. Never set text in the vivid shade.

rules.name: The Hours Are Words Rule
rules.body: Quantities always carry their unit in plain words.

dos: Do keep glass to chrome and content on solid surfaces.
Do use capsules for every control and concentric radii for nested containers.
Do show the Journey wherever a request appears and say in words who it waits on.
Do keep body text ≥16px and controls ≥40px tall.
donts: Don't put readable text directly on the ambient bloom or on glass without a solid backing behind long text.
Don't set text in the vivid system colors; use the text shades.
Don't return to flat gray grouped lists with hairline-bordered sidebars (that is v1, tag v1-classic).
Don't add a second accent color.
